e.title: 纯 PostgreSQL 的核保规则引擎：两种求值策略会合法地互相矛盾，并刻意播种演示数据把分歧摆出来
e.title_en: A pure-PostgreSQL underwriting rules engine whose two evaluation strategies can legitimately contradict each other, with demo data deliberately seeded to expose the divergence
e.title_hk: 純 PostgreSQL 的核保規則引擎：兩種求值策略會合法地互相矛盾，並刻意播種演示資料把分歧擺出來
e.summary: 一个完全建在 PostgreSQL 里的数据驱动核保规则引擎：产品、问题与规则全在表里，新增产品或调整规则只是改数据而非改代码；它并列提供两种求值策略——「全量求值」（取所有命中规则中最严重的结果）与「短路求值」（按问题顺序遇到 stop_evaluation 规则即停），因为两者可能合法地给出不同结论，作者特意为每个产品都播种了一条会暴露该分歧的演示报价
e.summary_hk: 一個完全建在 PostgreSQL 裡的資料驅動核保規則引擎：產品、問題與規則全在表裡，新增產品或調整規則只是改資料而非改代碼；它並列提供兩種求值策略——「全量求值」（取所有命中規則中最嚴重的結果）與「短路求值」（按問題順序遇到 stop_evaluation 規則即停），因為兩者可能合法地給出不同結論，作者特意為每個產品都播種了一條會暴露該分歧的演示報價
e.summary_en: A data-driven underwriting rules engine built entirely in PostgreSQL: products, questions and rules all live in tables, so adding a product or changing a rule is a data change rather than a code change; it offers two evaluation strategies side by side — full evaluation, which returns the worst outcome among everything that matched, and short-circuit evaluation, which stops as soon as a rule flagged stop_evaluation fully matches — and because the two can legitimately disagree, the author has seeded a demo quote for every product that exposes the divergence
e.body:
**paco_uw** 是一个**完全建在 PostgreSQL 里的数据驱动核保规则引擎**（仓库 `pacordev/paco_uw`），**实测 ★1、fork 0、主语言 **PLpgSQL**、仓库体量 27 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**，**且其 README 全文未作任何许可声明**（**即**沉默**而非「声称而无文件」**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 8,307 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「不肯只给一个数」**中的**第二种：它让两种求值语义并存，并把两者会互相矛盾这件事做成演示数据**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**根目录实测只有 6 项**：**`.gitignore`、`README.md`、`docker-compose.yml`、**`goal.txt`**、`scripts/`、`sql/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「A data-driven insurance underwriting engine, **built entirely in PostgreSQL**. Products, questions, and rules all live in tables — **adding a new product or tweaking a rule is just a data change, not a code change**.」**；**并逐字指引**：**「If you want the full requirements, check `goal.txt`; for the full build history and **the API plan we haven’t started yet**, see `uw_plan.md`.」**。**核保决定取值逐字为四种**：**`accept`、`increase_premium`、`refer_to_insurer`、`decline`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「两种求值策略**可以合法地互相矛盾**，并且我们**刻意**为每个产品都播种了一条演示报价把分歧摆出来」是本条目最有价值的一句**——**逐字为**：**「We support two evaluation strategies side by side: **Model A — full evaluation** (`evaluate_quote_full`): looks at every answer, checks every rule, and gives back **the single worst outcome out of everything that matched**. **Model B — short-circuit evaluation** (`evaluate_quote_short_circuit`): walks the questions in order and bails out as soon as a rule flagged `stop_evaluation` fully matches, without bothering to look at later answers. If nothing stops the walk, it just falls back to whatever Model A would’ve said.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **紧接着逐字为**：**「**These two can legitimately disagree with each other** — Model B might return something milder than Model A if a worse rule only becomes decidable further down the question list. **We seeded a demo quote for every product that shows this divergence on purpose, so it’s easy to see** (check `sql/phase6_tests.sql`).」**——**即「**这两者可能合法地互相矛盾**——如果更严重的规则要到问题清单更靠后处才能判定，**Model B 可能给出比 Model A 更宽松的结果**。**我们为每个产品都播种了一条演示报价，**故意**展示这一分歧，以便一眼看到****」。⭐⭐⭐ **对做核保或规则系统的学生，这是本会话见到对**语义分歧**最正面的处理**：**多数系统会把「短路优化」当作纯性能优化，并默认它与全量求值等价**；**而这里明确承认**两者语义不同、会在具体案例上给出不同决定****，**并且**不是写进脚注，而是变成一组可运行的演示数据与测试****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该分歧在实现中确如所述**——**本次未运行其 80 项测试，未读 `sql/phase6_tests.sql`**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「永不复写历史，两种策略的结果即使互相矛盾也都留着」是本条目在可审计性上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「**`quote_evaluation`** — one row per evaluation run. **We never overwrite these, so both strategies’ results stick around even when they disagree, and every past decision stays auditable.** The only thing that writes here is `evaluate_and_record_quote` — **the evaluation functions themselves don’t touch the database, they just compute**.」**，**并另有一个视图**：**「`quote_latest_evaluation` (view) — the latest row per **`(quote_id, strategy)`**, for when you just want current status without caring about the history table’s rules.」**⭐⭐ **两点值得单独记**：**历史表**按 `(报价, 策略)` 分别保留最新值**，**即它**从不把两种策略合并成一个「当前状态」****；**而「求值函数本身不碰数据库、只做计算，唯一写库的是 `evaluate_and_record_quote`」把**纯计算**与**落库记录**分开**——**这正是让两种结论可以并存而不互相覆盖的结构前提**（**可与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「图在 Verifier 后结束」、第 330 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「append-only audit log」并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **两处「防意外匹配」的细节值得记**：**① 规则条件为**逐条 AND 的条件表**（`uw_rule_condition`：`question_id`、`operator`、`value`）**，**逐字说明「A rule with N of these needs all N to hold; **a rule with zero conditions never matches (didn’t want rules matching vacuously by accident)**」**——**即**零条件的规则永不命中**，**以免出现「空条件恒真」的漏洞**；**② 通用单条件求值函数 `uw_condition_matches(operator, condition_value, answer_text, answer_type)` 逐字标注「**An unanswered question never matches.**」**——**即**未回答不等于命中**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这两条边界在实现中无遗漏**——**本次未读 `sql/` 下任何文件**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Where things stand」一节把「做完的」与「故意没做的」分列，是本轮主题最直接的形态**——**逐字实测**：**「**✅ The database (done):** we built this in **6 phases, each one a separate file in `sql/`**, and **all 80 tests are green against Postgres 16**.」**，**六阶段逐字为**：**① 核心模式（products、questions、quote、quote_answer）② `product_question` 加 `expected_answer` ③ 规则引擎（`uw_rule`、条件、Model A／Model B）④ 求值历史（`quote_evaluation`、`evaluate_and_record_quote`）⑤ 生产加固（唯一性约束、索引、答案校验触发器）⑥ 种子数据（8 个产品）＋完整测试套件**；⭐⭐⭐ **并逐字列出**故意留在 v1 之外的两项**：**「**We deliberately left a couple of things out of v1: rule versioning** (editing a rule changes how *past* quotes would re-evaluate — **no snapshotting**), **and multi-quote-per-application modeling**.」**——**即「我们**故意**把两件事留在 v1 之外：**规则版本化**（**修改一条规则会改变**过去**报价的重新求值结果——**没有快照**），**以及一申请多报价的建模」**。⭐⭐⭐ **「修改规则会改变过去报价的重新求值结果」这一句是**对一个具体审计缺陷的明确承认**——**它不仅说「没做版本化」，还说清了**没做会导致什么****（**可与第 330 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「四个数字被刻意保持区分」并读——**两者都在处理**同一笔业务在不同时点取值不一致**的问题**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未开始的部分也写得很清楚，且含一处防泄漏的 API 设计**——**逐字为**：**「**🚧 The API layer (planned, not started):** we’re building this in Python + FastAPI, as **a thin layer that just calls into the SQL above — no business logic duplicated in app code**.」**，**草拟契约逐字含**：**`GET /products`；`GET /products/{code}/questions`（**「never returns `expected_answer` — that’d leak the answer key」**）；`POST /quotes`；`POST /quotes/{quote_id}/answers`；`POST /quotes/{quote_id}/evaluate`；`GET /quotes/{quote_id}`**。⭐⭐ **「永不返回 `expected_answer`——那会泄漏答案」这一句值得单独记**：**在**规则驱动的核保引擎**里，`expected_answer` 是为了测试与演示而存的**正确答案**；**把它从对外接口中排除，等于把**测试夹具**与**对外契约**分开****（**⚠️ 该 API 层**自述尚未开始****——**本词条**不主张**其存在或行为**）。**⑥ ⭐ **运行方式逐字实测且含一处务实的测试隔离**：**`docker compose up -d`（首次运行建模式并播种，此后复用）**；**`scripts/run_tests.sh`——逐字说明「runs the **80-test suite on demand, not part of container init** — safe to run repeatedly, cleans up after itself」**；**`scripts/reset_db.sh`——「nukes the volume and rebuilds from scratch, e.g. after editing a `sql/` file」**；**需要一个 `.env` 文件（否则不启动）**；**数据保存在 `uw_pgdata` 卷中**。⭐ **「测试**不属于容器初始化的一部分**、可反复运行、且会自行清理」是一个具体的工程安排**——**它避免了「每次起容器就跑测试」这类拖慢与副作用**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **数据模型逐字实测且是**规则即数据**的具体形态**：**`insurance_product`（一行一个产品，如 `LIFE_SIMPLE`、`AUTO_BASIC`——**「Adding a new product is just inserting a row here, plus its questions and rules below」**）**；**`uw_question`（**可跨产品复用的共享问题池**，每个有 `answer_type`（`boolean`／`number`／`text`／`enum`），enum 时 `enum_options` 存允许值）**；**`product_question`（`expected_answer` 所在）**；**`uw_outcome_rank`（严重度排序，**`accept`=1 … `decline`=4**，供 Model A 挑出「单一最严重结果」）**。**⑧ ⭐⚠️ **一处可核实的缺件**：**README 与它自己的「Project structure」代码块**都列出 `uw_plan.md`**（**且称其为「the living version… phase-by-phase, checked off as we go」**），**但**根目录实测 6 项中**没有 `uw_plan.md`****（**只有 `goal.txt`**）**——**本词条如实记录该引用指向一份根目录未列出的文件**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该文件不存在于其他位置**——**本次只实测了根目录，未遍历全部目录树**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站核保与规则引擎条目并读**：[[underwriting-workbench]]、[[underwriting-copilot]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[acord]]、[[claims-api]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**该仓库实测无任何许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 **404**），**且 README 全文不含任何许可声明**。**本词条明确记录：未声明许可即意味着**默认保留全部权利**，**在使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**（**本条属「沉默」一类，与同轮声称许可而无文件的条目后果不同**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单（6 项）与 README（8,307 字节）全文的定位段、两种求值策略、历史表说明、数据模型各表、核心函数表、六阶段与故意省略项、API 草拟契约、运行方式与项目结构块**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未启动 `docker compose`、未运行 `scripts/run_tests.sh`（**其自述的 80 项测试本次完全未运行**）、未执行任何 SQL、未读 `sql/` 下 {phase1…phase6} 任何文件、未读 `scripts/` 下任何脚本、未读 `goal.txt`、未访问数据库****，因此**不能转述其模式定义、触发器实现、种子数据的 8 个产品内容、两个求值函数的具体 SQL 或其任何查询结果**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「两种求值策略会在具体报价上给出不同结论」以及「每个产品都播种了一条展示该分歧的演示报价」**——**本词条只核实到它们被如此描述**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「80 项测试在 Postgres 16 上全绿」**（**未运行任何测试**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「`quote_evaluation` 永不复写、求值函数不碰数据库」在实现中是否成立**（**未读 `sql/phase4…`**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「零条件的规则永不匹配」与「未回答的问题永不匹配」这两条边界**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实** `uw_plan.md` 是否存在**（**根目录实测未列出**；**本次未遍历全部目录树**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其种子数据中「8 个产品」的具体内容**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **核保决定直接影响**是否承保与以何费率承保****，**在多数辖区属**受监管的保险业务动作****；**一个自述 v1、无许可、未做规则版本化、且 API 层尚未开始的规则引擎**，**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的核保、报价、承保或监管报送**；**⚠️ 其自述的「没有快照，改规则会改变过去报价的重新求值结果」本身就是一条**不适合直接用于生产审计**的已知限制**；**⑩ ⭐ ★1、fork 0**，**关注度极低**（**★1 略高于同批其他条目**），**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/pacordev/paco_uw`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 8,307 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对，含两种求值策略段、分歧播种说明、历史表说明、六阶段与故意省略项、API 草拟契约与项目结构块）；**未克隆、未启动容器、未运行任何测试或 SQL、未读 `sql/` 与 `scripts/`、未读 `goal.txt`**。
e.body_hk:
**paco_uw** 是一個**完全建在 PostgreSQL 裡的資料驅動核保規則引擎**（倉庫 `pacordev/paco_uw`），**實測 ★1、fork 0、主語言 **PLpgSQL**、體量 27 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-07**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 404）**，**且 README 全文未作任何許可聲明**（**即**沉默**而非「聲稱而無文件」**）；**無 topics**；**README 實測 8,307 位元組**。本條目屬本輪主題**「不肯只給一個數」**中的**第二種：它讓兩種求值語義並存，並把兩者會互相矛盾這件事做成演示資料**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**根目錄實測只有 6 項**：**`.gitignore`、`README.md`、`docker-compose.yml`、**`goal.txt`**、`scripts/`、`sql/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **定位逐字**：**「A data-driven insurance underwriting engine, **built entirely in PostgreSQL**. Products, questions, and rules all live in tables — **adding a new product or tweaking a rule is just a data change, not a code change**.」**；**並逐字指引**「If you want the full requirements, check `goal.txt`; for the full build history and **the API plan we haven’t started yet**, see `uw_plan.md`.」**。**核保決定取值逐字四種**：**`accept`、`increase_premium`、`refer_to_insurer`、`decline`**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「兩種求值策略**可以合法地互相矛盾**，並且我們**刻意**為每個產品都播種了一條演示報價把分歧擺出來」是最有價值的一句**——**逐字**：**「We support two evaluation strategies side by side: **Model A — full evaluation** (`evaluate_quote_full`): looks at every answer, checks every rule, and gives back **the single worst outcome out of everything that matched**. **Model B — short-circuit evaluation** (`evaluate_quote_short_circuit`): walks the questions in order and bails out as soon as a rule flagged `stop_evaluation` fully matches, without bothering to look at later answers. If nothing stops the walk, it just falls back to whatever Model A would’ve said.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **緊接逐字**：**「**These two can legitimately disagree with each other** — Model B might return something milder than Model A if a worse rule only becomes decidable further down the question list. **We seeded a demo quote for every product that shows this divergence on purpose, so it’s easy to see** (check `sql/phase6_tests.sql`).」**⭐⭐⭐ **對做核保或規則系統的學生，這是本會話見到對**語義分歧**最正面的處理**：**多數系統會把「短路優化」當作純性能優化，並預設它與全量求值等價**；**而這裡明確承認**兩者語義不同、會在具體案例上給出不同決定****，**並且**不是寫進腳註，而是變成一組可運行的演示資料與測試****（**⚠️ 不主張**該分歧在實現中確如所述**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「永不復寫歷史，兩種策略的結果即使互相矛盾也都留著」是可審計性上最值得記的一處**——**逐字**：**「**`quote_evaluation`** — one row per evaluation run. **We never overwrite these, so both strategies’ results stick around even when they disagree, and every past decision stays auditable.** The only thing that writes here is `evaluate_and_record_quote` — **the evaluation functions themselves don’t touch the database, they just compute**.」**，**並另有視圖**「`quote_latest_evaluation` (view) — the latest row per **`(quote_id, strategy)`**」**⭐⭐ **兩點值得單獨記**：**歷史表**按（報價，策略）分別保留最新值，**即它**從不把兩種策略合併成一個「當前狀態」****；**而「求值函數本身不碰資料庫、只做計算」把**純計算**與**落庫記錄**分開**——**這正是讓兩種結論可以並存而不互相覆蓋的結構前提**（可與第 329 輪 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]、第 330 輪 [[claim-to-confidence]] 並讀）。**③ ⭐⭐ **兩處「防意外匹配」的細節**：① 規則條件為**逐條 AND 的條件表**，**逐字「a rule with zero conditions never matches (didn’t want rules matching vacuously by **paco_uw** is **a data-driven underwriting rules engine built entirely in PostgreSQL** (repository `pacordev/paco_uw`), with **measured ★1, 0 forks, PLpgSQL as the primary language, a 27 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main) and its README makes no licence statement at all** (a **silent** case rather than a claim without a file); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 8,307 bytes**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **refusing to give just one number**: **it lets two evaluation semantics coexist and turns the fact that they can contradict each other into demo data**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the root measurably contains exactly six items**: **`.gitignore`, `README.md`, `docker-compose.yml`, `goal.txt`, `scripts/` and `sql/`**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"A data-driven insurance underwriting engine, built entirely in PostgreSQL. Products, questions, and rules all live in tables — adding a new product or tweaking a rule is just a data change, not a code change."**; **and it points verbatim**: **"If you want the full requirements, check `goal.txt`; for the full build history and the API plan we haven’t started yet, see `uw_plan.md`."** **The four underwriting outcomes read verbatim**: **`accept`, `increase_premium`, `refer_to_insurer` and `decline`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That its two evaluation strategies can legitimately contradict each other, and that demo quotes were deliberately seeded to expose the divergence for every product, is the entry’s most valuable point** — verbatim: **"We support two evaluation strategies side by side: Model A — full evaluation (`evaluate_quote_full`): looks at every answer, checks every rule, and gives back the single worst outcome out of everything that matched. Model B — short-circuit evaluation (`evaluate_quote_short_circuit`): walks the questions in order and bails out as soon as a rule flagged `stop_evaluation` fully matches, without bothering to look at later answers. If nothing stops the walk, it just falls back to whatever Model A would’ve said."**; ⭐⭐⭐ **immediately followed verbatim by**: **"These two can legitimately disagree with each other — Model B might return something milder than Model A if a worse rule only becomes decidable further down the question list. We seeded a demo quote for every product that shows this divergence on purpose, so it’s easy to see (check `sql/phase6_tests.sql`)."** ⭐⭐⭐ **For students of underwriting or rules systems this is the most forthright treatment of semantic divergence this session has seen: most systems treat short-circuiting as a pure performance optimisation and assume it is equivalent to full evaluation, whereas here the two are explicitly acknowledged to differ in semantics and to yield different decisions on concrete cases — and that is not a footnote but a runnable set of demo data and tests** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the divergence is as described in the implementation — its 80 tests were not run and `sql/phase6_tests.sql` was not read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Never overwriting history, so both strategies’ results survive even when they contradict each other, is the entry’s most notable auditability point** — verbatim: **"`quote_evaluation` — one row per evaluation run. We never overwrite these, so both strategies’ results stick around even when they disagree, and every past decision stays auditable. The only thing that writes here is `evaluate_and_record_quote` — the evaluation functions themselves don’t touch the database, they just compute."**, **with a further view**: **"`quote_latest_evaluation` (view) — the latest row per `(quote_id, strategy)`"**. ⭐⭐ **Two points deserve separate note**: **the latest-value view is per quote and per strategy, so the two strategies are never collapsed into one current state**; **and separating pure computation (the evaluation functions) from persistence (the single recording function) is the structural precondition that lets two conclusions coexist without overwriting each other** (**readable with round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] and round 330’s [[claim-to-confidence]] and its append-only audit log**). **③ ⭐⭐ Two anti-accident details deserve note**: **① rule conditions are an AND-ed condition table (`uw_rule_condition`), stated verbatim as "a rule with N of these needs all N to hold; a rule with zero conditions never matches (didn’t want rules matching vacuously by accident)"** — **a zero-condition rule never matches, closing the vacuous-truth hole**; **② the generic single-condition function `uw_condition_matches(operator, condition_value, answer_text, answer_type)` is annotated verbatim "An unanswered question never matches."** (**⚠️ no file under `sql/` was read, so the entry does not claim these boundaries are complete**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A "Where things stand" section separates what is finished from what was deliberately omitted, the most direct form of this round’s theme** — verbatim: **"✅ The database (done): we built this in 6 phases, each one a separate file in `sql/`, and all 80 tests are green against Postgres 16."**, **the six phases reading verbatim as**: **① core schema (products, questions, quote, quote_answer) ② `expected_answer` added to `product_question` ③ the rules engine (`uw_rule`, conditions, Model A / Model B) ④ evaluation history (`quote_evaluation`, `evaluate_and_record_quote`) ⑤ production hardening (uniqueness constraints, indexes, the answer-validation trigger) ⑥ seed data (8 products) plus the full test suite**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and then naming verbatim what was deliberately left out of v1**: **"We deliberately left a couple of things out of v1: rule versioning (editing a rule changes how *past* quotes would re-evaluate — no snapshotting), and multi-quote-per-application modeling."** ⭐⭐⭐ **That parenthetical is an explicit acknowledgement of a specific audit defect: it does not merely say versioning is absent, it says what its absence causes** (**readable with round 330’s [[claim-to-confidence]] and its four numbers deliberately kept distinct — both deal with the same transaction taking different values at different times**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ The unfinished part is also described clearly, and includes one leak-guarding API decision** — verbatim: **"🚧 The API layer (planned, not started): we’re building this in Python + FastAPI, as a thin layer that just calls into the SQL above — no business logic duplicated in app code."**, **with a draft contract including `GET /products/{code}/questions`, which reads verbatim "(never returns `expected_answer` — that’d leak the answer key)"**. ⭐⭐ **In a rule-driven underwriting engine `expected_answer` is the stored correct answer used for testing and demonstration; excluding it from the public interface separates a test fixture from a public contract** (**⚠️ that API layer is self-described as not started — the entry does not claim it exists or behaves in any way**). **⑥ ⭐ How it runs reads verbatim and includes a practical test isolation**: **`docker compose up -d`** (first run builds schema and seed data, thereafter reused); **`scripts/run_tests.sh` — verbatim "runs the 80-test suite on demand, not part of container init — safe to run repeatedly, cleans up after itself"**; **`scripts/reset_db.sh` — verbatim "nukes the volume and rebuilds from scratch"**; **a `.env` file is required or it will not start**; **and data persists in the `uw_pgdata` volume**. ⭐ **"Tests are not part of container init, can be run repeatedly and clean up after themselves" is a concrete engineering arrangement that avoids both the slowness and the side effects of testing on every container start.** **⑦ ⭐⭐ The data model reads verbatim and is what "rules as data" looks like concretely**: **`insurance_product`** (one row per product, e.g. `LIFE_SIMPLE`, `AUTO_BASIC` — **"Adding a new product is just inserting a row here, plus its questions and rules below"**); **`uw_question`** (**a shared pool of questions reusable across products**, each with an `answer_type` of `boolean`, `number`, `text` or `enum`, with `enum_options` holding the allowed values for enums); **`product_question`**; **and `uw_outcome_rank`** (**a severity ranking, `accept`=1 … `decline`=4, that Model A uses to pick the single worst outcome**). **⑧ ⭐⚠️ One verifiable missing item**: **both the README body and its own "Project structure" block list `uw_plan.md`** (calling it **"the living version… phase-by-phase, checked off as we go"**), **yet the six-item root listing contains no `uw_plan.md`** (**only `goal.txt`**) — **the entry records that the reference points at a file not present at the root** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the file does not exist elsewhere — only the root was measured, not the whole tree**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s underwriting and rules-engine entries**: [[underwriting-workbench]], [[underwriting-copilot]], [[agentic-bop-underwriting]], [[underwriting-decision-safety]], [[openrater]], [[ratecraft]], [[acord]], [[claims-api]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main), and the README contains no licence statement whatsoever**. **No licence declaration means all rights are by default reserved, and authorisation must be confirmed before use, modification or redistribution** (**this is a silent case, with different consequences from claiming a licence without the file**); **③ ⭐⭐⭐ That the two strategies yield different conclusions on specific quotes, and that a demo quote exposing the divergence is seeded for every product, were not verified** — **only that they are described that way**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The claim that all 80 tests are green against Postgres 16 was not verified** (**no test was run**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether "`quote_evaluation` is never overwritten and the evaluation functions never touch the database" holds in the implementation was not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ The two boundaries ("a zero-condition rule never matches" and "an unanswered question never matches") were not verified**; **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether `uw_plan.md` exists was not verified** (**the root listing does not show it; the whole tree was not walked**); **⑧ ⭐ The concrete content of the eight seed products was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Underwriting decisions directly determine whether and at what rate risk is accepted**, **a regulated insurance operation in most jurisdictions**; **⚠️ its own stated lack of snapshots — so that editing a rule changes how past quotes would re-evaluate — is itself a known limitation unsuited to production audit**; **⑩ ⭐ At ★1 and 0 forks attention is very low** (**★1 is slightly above the other entries in this batch**), **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**;
